entityName: Center for International Forestry Research (CIFOR) Germany gGmbH
entityDescription:
Purpose of the company 
1. The purpose if the company is the advancement of science and research of in the field if sustainable forestry, that is both intergeneratively and intrageneretively resilient and ecologically, economically, politically and socially sustainable forestry, to facilitate and promote multi-sector, multi –disciplined development and collaboration and the advancement of development cooperation.
2. The purpose is realized in particular by:
a) facilitating and undertaking collaborative strategic and applied research and related activities in forest landscapes and forestry
b) Advancement of forestry science and by informing forest policy and management that contribute to sustainable development and human well-being 
c) promoting the transfer of appropriate new technologies and technologies for achieving forest and timber sustainability for the sustainable well –being of people globally and especially in the tropical and low income countries 
d) introduction of new methods of social organization and governance for national development.
e)securing and improving the livelihood of populations dependent on the forests, raising the importance of forest in the global development agenda , in doing so the forest is recognized as an outstanding ecosystem , which may be more or less unstable depending on the vegetation zone
f) protection of the remaining rain forests, through their sustainable management and conservation
g) undertake capacity building and communication, outreach and engagement as an integral part of the research agenda to accelerate uptake and action to contribute to the sustainable development agenda 

3 “Forestry” means the science, the art and the practice of managing and using for human benefit the natural resources that occur on and in association with lands bearing forest or with a forest professions. A “forest system” is a functional complex of forest and its biophysical, social, cultural, economic and political environment

HSH Informatica e Cultura S.r.l. was founded in 1985 in Matera, Italy. It operates in the advanced tertiary sector as a technical service provider in the engineering sector, HSH supplies its services in the areas of Earth observation, geospatial analysis, computational resources and data intensive computation, mainly to Public Administation bodies and large Engineering Companies. In 2000 HSH spun out its activities related to the processing of Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) to a new company called Innova Consorzio per l'Informatica e la Telematica srl, keeping in house all activities related to the management of research projects and support activities to the Cosmo-Sky-Med program and other projects of the Italian Space Agency such ROSA (Radio Occultation Sounder for Atmosphere) and Cosmo SkyMed.
HSH has been involved in the management of many industrial and scientific research projects funded by the Italian Ministries of Economic Development (MISE) and of Education, Universities and Research (MIUR) and TeRN (Technologies for Earth Observation and Natural Risks) Consortium. HSH is currently involved in the 5G experimentation activities in Italy.

AVIASPACE BREMEN is an association of dedicated companies and application-oriented research institutes in and around the federal state of Bremen. This network implements the federal state of Bremen’s strategy for the aeronautics and space industries.The association’s objective is to improve cooperation and develop innovative projects in and around the federal state of Bremen as a business and science center. Its scope covers the aeronautics and space industries and other technologies related to this area whose members have specific competences. AVIASPACE BREMEN connects companies, scientific institutions and authorities. It focuses on topics such as networking, technology transfer, and economic growth through promotion of start-ups and young entrepreneurs. The purpose is to develop a technical and organizational network of producers of end-products, suppliers and service providers, and scientific institutions in the fields of materials science, highlift systems, engineering, manufacturing technology, earth observation, and robotics.More than fifty of the companies and institutes working in the aeronautics and space industries in Bremen have already joined AVIASPACE BREMEN.

entityDescription: SentinAir is a spin-off of the French Space Agency (CNES) that was created on April 2018. A good management of air quality we breathe requires above all a high resolution measurement of air pollutants. The objective of SentinAir is to exploit a patent initially developed for Earth Observation from space in order to develop and deploy on-ground autonomous remote sensing networks that provides high resolution air quality monitoring in real-time over an entire urban area.

entityDescription: BAB is the regional development bank and financial services provider of the federal state of Bremen. It supports the state of Bremen in its implementation of its state development, structure, economic and housing policies. BAB supports companies in every phase of development, especially small and medium-sized companies, both with financial and business support programmes. However, with the ongoing interest in start-ups and creating new companies, BAB established “STARTHAUS Bremen” on behalf of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, Labour and Ports in Bremen (SWAH). STARTHAUS Bremen is a multifunctional one-stop-agency supporting all aspects of business formation by involving a range of diverse partners and programmes: support whilst setting up a company, business plan consulting, coaching, finance facilities as well as co-working space and special networking events. Since 2003 BAB has been supporting more than 130 start-ups with its BRUT programme, which offers financial and business support in a modular way. The new integrated STARTHAUS concept offers start-ups bespoke training and development measures and complements their journey via a mentoring system. Coaching and qualification offers are supplemented by financing options – from grants to loans and venture capital. BAB also provides close contacts to regional Business Angel networks and to business experts to assist companies and start-ups with their know-how and practical advice.

entityDescription:
Global Geo-Intelligence Solutions (GGIS) is a geospatial data analytics company. It was founded in January 2016. We utilise data from earth observation satellites, global navigation satellite systems and other data sources to provide decision support intelligence to end users. We provide geospatial intelligence and engineering solutions for resource and infrastructure monitoring and management through the use of statistical analysis, machine learning and data mining techniques. We have a strong desire to see technology used to assist communities around the world to not be victims of environmental related events and circumstance but rather to be able to rise above it and thrive. Between Nov 2017 to September 2018 GGIS conducted a feasibility study for the Caribbean Agricultural Research and Development Institute (CARDI) on the use of satellite data to assess the impact of the 2017 hurricane season on the agriculture sector of three countries in the region which were affected. These were Dominica, Antigua & Barbuda and St Kitts & Nevis. The feasibility study also included capacity building workshops on the use of satellite earth observation and GNSS in agriculture.
In May 2021 GGIS (along with partners in the university and rescue sector) successfully received funding from the Templeton Foundation to investigate the impacting of intersecting crises such as natural disasters and socio-economic issues on human trafficking/forced or illegal labour in the Bahamas.
In September 2020 we were selected as a member of one of the 15 consortiums to take part in the H2020 PARSEC Accelerator. Through this one year program we have developed and since launched our Foresight Carbon Service which uses satellite earth observation data, GNSS and machine learning to measure and monitor carbon sequestration in forests.
Our team of 3-4 people bring in several years of experience in geospatial data analysis, satellite surveying and mapping, remote sensing (radar and optical multi-spectral), machine learning, programming and cloud computing amongst others.

entityDescription:
HPP International is an affiliated company of HPP Architekten GmbH, one of Germany’s most successful architectural partnerships. 
As a result of the internationalization of markets, working on projects and receiving commissions outside of Germany has become as usual as collaborating with other specialists across national borders. HPP International Planungsgesellschaft mbH was founded in 1977 and carries out architectural and master planning projects both abroad and for foreign clients. We have amassed skills, contacts and experience in over 40 years of working internationally. Our current focus is in the burgeoning regions of South-East Europe and Asia. 
HPP International is a wholly-owned subsidiary of HPP Architekten GmbH and is responsible for the management of international plannings and is also involved in project development and project management. We assist our partners in identifying sites, in the conceptual phase and in the procurement of planning permission and thereby benefit from the country-specific knowledge and experience of our employees from 13 different nations. 
The head office of HPP Architekten GmbH is based in Düsseldorf’s Media Harbor. Further HPP offices are located in Amsterdam, Berlin, Cologne, Frankfurt, Hamburg, Leipzig, Munich, Stuttgart, Istanbul, Beijing, Shanghai and Shenzhen. HPP International's offices are located in Düsseldorf and Berlin. Through this network we are able to benefit from local knowledge, ease of availability and good relationships to the most important local contacts. 
Among the well-known international projects are the Expo Village and the Henkel Asia-Pacific and China Headquarter in Shanghai, the AND Tower in Istanbul, the Baltic Arena in Gdansk, the Standard Bank Centre in Johannesburg, the Swan Office in Bucharest as well as the German Embassy in Washington. Under construction are currently the Multifunctional Arena in Ekaterinburg, the Alibaba Campus in Hangzhou, the Pudong Soccer Arena in Shanghai and the Taicang Campus of the Jiaotong-Liverpool University in Xi'an. Recently completed are the Yotrio Tower in Ningbo, the North Station Huide Tower in Shenzhen and the residential and mixed-use complex AND Pastel in Istanbul.

With its “no-coding-needed” approach, smart contracts get generated, deployed and updated automatically into different blockchains. Unibright works with visual, usecase-related templates and also automatically integrates existing IT systems into the blockchain.

Unibright Solutions, a dedicated consulting branch to support blockchain use in business processes, was additionally launched in December 2018.

More information on Unibright: https://unibright.io
Unibright Blockchain Consulting Services: https://unibright.solutions

entityDescription: Panda Insight, founded in 2019 in Germany, is an SME in the human health sector. A "One Size Fits All Approach" doesn't work in health care. Our platform provides personalized and contextual real-time advice based on AI to improve health, lifestyle and mental well-being. We integrate behavioral and data-driven interventions with state-of-the-art AI/ML approaches to facilitate a healthy lifestyle. We help to understand how a patient’s behavior affects therapy outcomes and what actions can be taken towards improvement. We track the user’s actions against clear feedback loops of health data and then suggest personalized actions based on their health data. We are specialized in building individually trained models for health data. This also includes psychological parameters on stress and mental well-being.

entityDescription:
pbr Planungsbüro Rohling AG is one of the largest German Design, Engineering and Management Consultants for the construction industry. About 550 employees situated in 12 branch offices in Germany provide services to our national and international clients. More than half a century of experience in planning and design and a continuous accumulation of knowledge are the basis for the successful execution of a wide variety of building projects. The pbr team provides a range of services including Architecture, Structural and Civil Engineering as well as Mechanical and Electrical Engineering. pbr AG provides its clients with a comprehensive project management service. Our company’s multidisciplinary structure allows us to offer our clients a combination of excellent professional design and integrated solutions.
Founding Year: 1960
Company Form: Stock Company (since 01.01.1996)
Share Capital: 2.0 Million €
Register of Companies: District Court of Osnabrück, HRB 18010
Company Objective: According to the articles of association the aim of pbr Planungsbüro Rohling AG is the creative, technical and efficient planning of buildings and mechanical & electrical engineering for building construction, structural and civil engineering, and consultancy, continuous support and supervision during the realization phase.
